main_text.p: pejora infecuta essent, pessimis temporibus, post tot enatas novas, veteres renatas hæreses, multo difficilior: Vires, cum vel maxime vigerent, admodum exiguæ; & tunc accrescentibus annis fractæ plurimum imminutæque: Memoria fragilis & infida: Impediti oris, in hac etiam balbescente fenestute, infantia: Vel ipsius Latini sermonis, post quinque tum superque lustrorum absentiam, infolentia. Perorandi, prælegendi, disputandi, determinandi, cæteraque quæ hujusce sunt muneris præstandi (quæ fortassis ab his exigi fas est, qui assidui sunt in hac palæstra) facultas siqua olim inerat, quum in his studiis aliquantulum versaremur, (& quantilla tum illa!) exoleta jam prorsus, & plane nulla. Denique, ut minutiora illa præteream, longinquæ migrationis cum famulatu & supellectile qua libraria qua domestica, tædium, reliquaque ab re familiari incommoda: vel

page.notes: The text is set in italic type throughout; the italic type is shown as plain text. Some words are uncertain in the scan (for example "fenestute", "balbescente", "studiis") and were transcribed as printed. The last line "vel" stands at the right margin.
